# IO ESTABLISHMENT
# 鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€鈹€

tv_conquest_establishment_basic_requirement = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_CONQUEST_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP1_REQUIREMENT
		has_variable = tv_conquest_score
		var:tv_conquest_score >= 50
	}
}

tv_conquest_headquarters_can_build_in_location = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_CONQUEST_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_REQUIREMENT
		owner ?= scope:actor
		is_capital = yes
		location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tv_conquest_headquarters }
		NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_conquest_headquarters }
		NOT = {
			any_buildings_in_location = {
				building_type = building_type:tv_conquest_headquarters
				building_levels_under_construction >= 1
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_conquest_headquarters_can_build_in_capital = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_CONQUEST_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_REQUIREMENT
		capital ?= {
			is_capital = yes
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tv_conquest_headquarters }
			NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_conquest_headquarters }
			NOT = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					building_type = building_type:tv_conquest_headquarters
					building_levels_under_construction >= 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_CONQUEST_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP1_DONE_TT
		has_variable = tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done
	}
}

tv_conquest_establishment_headquarters_done = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_CONQUEST_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_DONE_TT
		capital ?= { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = tv_conquest_headquarters }
	}
}

tv_conquest_establishment_ready_to_appoint = {
	tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done = yes
	tv_conquest_establishment_headquarters_done = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
	custom_tooltip = {
	  text = TV_CONQUEST_M1_EXTRA_TRIGGER_DESC
	  is_subject = no
	}
}

tv_trade_establishment_ready_to_appoint = {

	tv_trade_establishment_headquarters_done = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_victory_enabled }
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		any_country = {
			count < 10
			is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = tv_trade_league }
		}
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_DIPLOMATIC_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_REQUIREMENT
		owner ?= scope:actor
		is_capital = yes
		location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tv_diplomatic_headquarters }
		NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_diplomatic_headquarters }
		NOT = {
			any_buildings_in_location = {
				building_type = building_type:tv_diplomatic_headquarters
				building_levels_under_construction >= 1
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_diplomatic_headquarters_can_build_in_capital = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_DIPLOMATIC_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_REQUIREMENT
		capital ?= {
			is_capital = yes
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tv_diplomatic_headquarters }
			NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_diplomatic_headquarters }
			NOT = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					building_type = building_type:tv_diplomatic_headquarters
					building_levels_under_construction >= 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_DIPLOMATIC_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP1_DONE_TT
		has_variable = tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done
	}
}

tv_diplomatic_establishment_headquarters_done = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = TV_DIPLOMATIC_ESTABLISHMENT_STEP2_DONE_TT
		capital ?= { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = tv_diplomatic_headquarters }
	}
}

tv_diplomatic_establishment_ready_to_appoint = {
	tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done = yes
	tv_diplomatic_establishment_headquarters_done = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
}
